subject: Halo renewal + expansion: request for pricing stability and credits
messages:
From: Anna Kim <anna.kim@halo-systems.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal + expansion — pricing ask and usage report

Hi Evelyn,

Quick note from Halo as we start our renewal planning: we had a much larger than expected usage spike in Q3 (attached), and we expect to add two additional inference workers (equivalent to ~2x current reserved capacity) over the next 60 days to support a new product line.

Before we lock in the renewal, procurement asked whether Redwood can:
- provide a 6-month price hold on current list rates (we're sensitive to market fluctuation),
- extend a one-time credit to offset Q3 overage, and
- offer a preliminary uplift discount on the renewed retainer if we commit to the expanded capacity (targeting an incremental 1.5–2.0M tokens/month).

Can you share what concessions are possible and whether you need an expected commit number or PO to proceed? Attaching our usage export for October.

Thanks — happy to jump on a call Wednesday if that's easier.

Anna Kim
Head of Cloud Operations, Halo Systems
anna.kim@halo-systems.com
+1 415-555-0147

Attachments: halo-usage-oct.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Kim <anna.kim@halo-systems.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion — pricing ask and usage report

Anna — thanks for the heads up and the usage attachment. Appreciate the detail.

Short answer: yes, we can structure options that protect Halo from short-term list increases while also making the uplift economical for Redwood. To make the right ask to Finance / Ops I need two quick items from you:
1) a target committed tokens/month once you scale (a single number or a narrow range),
2) an approximate go-live timeline for the additional workers (weeks from signature).

As a first pass I'm attaching a high-level proposal (redwood-proposal-v1.pdf) with two pathways — one that prioritizes a deeper one-time credit in exchange for a firm commit, and one that prioritizes a longer price hold with a modest discount. If possible, pick the pathway and I'll route internally for approvals.

If you prefer, let's do a 30-minute call Wednesday 10am PT — I can bring Finance (Marissa) and CS Ops (David) so we can lock on terms.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0192

Attachment: redwood-proposal-v1.pdf (proposal, 125KB)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 10:30:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: Halo renewal — options to present

Team — looping you in with Halo's usage sheet; they want a price hold + credit and are open to committing to more reserved capacity. My read: closing this expansion is high-propensity (product launch dependency). My proposed options to surface to the customer:

Option A (preferred):
- 15% discount on renewed retainer for 12 months
- $50,000 one-time credit applied across first two invoices (to offset Q3 overage)
- 3-month price hold on list rates from signature
- Customer commits to incremental reserved capacity equivalent to 2 GPUs (~target 1.8M tokens/mo) for 12 months

Option B:
- 10% discount on renewed retainer
- 6-month price hold on list rates
- No one-time credit; instead offer a one-time burst credit bucket (20k tokens)
- Customer commits to flexible reserved capacity with a 6-mo ramp plan

Notes/asks for Finance/Legal:
- Marissa: will Finance accept the $50k offset as a contra-credit (applied across invoices) and still meet revenue recognition timelines? If so, we'll prepare an amendment.
- Monica: please call out any legal/contract risk with a short-term price hold + credit structure.

If we agree, I will present Option A to Halo on Thursday's call and ask for a signature window and PO.

Evelyn

> On Mon, Nov 2, 2026 at 11:05 AM Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Anna — thanks for the heads up...

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Internal: Halo renewal — options to present

Evelyn — good options. Finance is comfortable with Option A provided we get a clean PO and the credit is documented as a one-time contra (not refundable) applied over invoices 1 and 2. A couple of operational asks:

- Please capture Deal ID (DEAL-2026-1347-HALO) and include it on the amendment.
- We need a signed amendment before the new reserved capacity goes live; invoice timing will follow the amendment effective date.
- Attached is a redlined amendment template that captures the 15% discount + $50k credit structure (Halo_AMEND_v1.docx).

Once legal signs off on the redline I can approve and release the credit. Also we'll need the customer's billing contact and PO number for our billing system.

Marissa Cole

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, procurement@halo-systems.com
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 15:47:00 -0800
Subject: Offer: Renewal + expansion terms (summary & next steps)

Hi Anna — great conversation this morning. Summarizing Redwood's offer so Halo has something formal to circulate to procurement: 

Summary of offer (what we're prepared to sign):
- Commercial: 15% discount on the renewed annual retainer for 12 months (applies to base retainer only)
- Credit: $50,000 one-time contra credit to offset Q3 overage, applied evenly across invoices 1 and 2 post-effective date
- Price hold: 3-month guarantee on list rates from amendment effective date (protects you from short-term price moves)
- Commit/Capacity: Halo to commit to incremental reserved capacity equivalent to 2 GPUs (~target 1.8M tokens/month) for 12 months; we can stage activation over 6 weeks after signature
- Operational: signed amendment required before reserved capacity goes live; PO and billing contact requested.

Attachments & next steps:
- Attached: redwood-offer-summary.pdf (formal summary) and the redlined amendment (as discussed).
- DocuSign link to the amendment: https://na3.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abcdef-123456
- HubSpot record (for ease of reference): https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

If Halo confirms the commit (1.8M tokens/mo / 2 GPUs) and provides PO + billing contact by EOD Thursday, we will:
1) route the amendment for signature via DocuSign,
2) schedule capacity activation with our infra team (target within 6 weeks of signature), and
3) apply the $50k credit across the first two invoices.

Please reply with the PO number or any follow-up questions. Happy to jump on one more call to walk procurement through the credit mechanics.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this done.

Evelyn Hart
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0192
